_comment: Read by scripts/make_case.py. The values are the solved runs'. SI units, kelvin. x across the rows, y along them, z up.
_T0: the air at rest and the supply, 20 C (68 F)
_supplyMassFlow: kg/s through each end wall's grilles (supply_south, supply_north), 159.204 kg/s in all: exactly the racks' draw, 1,200 x 0.13267 (the operator's 1.00x)
_serverMassFlow: kg/s through each server, intake and exhaust alike: 2 kW at a 15 K rise, 2000 / (1005 x 15)
_serverRise: K added to each server's intake air at its exhaust (outletMappedUniformInlet offset)
_rhoRef: kg/m3, the flowRate conditions' density for their starting value only; the solver uses the face density
_returnBackflowT: K of anything drawn back in through a ceiling return: the exhaust's 35 C
